_about: The one sun every object's cast shadow is projected by (docs/world-editor.md, 'The sun'): a texel h above the ground lands cast[0] h east and cast[1] h south, in texels. Read by scripts/art/sun.py (the painted zones' bake, native compose.SHADOW, and the kit's prop masks, props.footprint_shadow) and by the live ground (TerrainGround.sun()). Trees' crown masks (props.crown_shadow) and houses' volumes (native/volume.house_cast) read it too: one sun, south-east, which night never rotates (Matt, 27 Nov; eastward-edges 11.6).
